commands.name: DanOS Home / Cockpit Overview
commands.description: Calm local cockpit overview: registry, tasks, agents, cmux/tmux readiness, and next actions.
commands.command: bin/cmux-cockpit-page home -- cd "$HOME/Code/hermes-cli-cockpit" && bin/danos init --seed-workspaces >/dev/null && bin/danos home

commands.name: Herdr Ops / Agent Session Pilot
commands.description: Separate Herdr-owned agent PTY pilot on the MBP. Does not touch mission tmux or the gateway.
commands.command: bin/cmux-cockpit-page agents -- ssh -tt mbp-runtime 'PATH=/Users/openclaw/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; if command -v herdr >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec herdr --session danos-herdr; else printf "Herdr is not installed on the MBP pilot path yet.\n"; exec zsh -l; fi'

commands.name: Obsidian Vault
commands.description: Open canonical Hermes Obsidian vault (terminal cwd + Obsidian or Finder).
